Latin.anchor: Nati sunt autem eis filii duo masculi: quorum unus quidem prior, appellabatur cain, quod nomen interpraetatum significat possessio

English.anchor: Adam and Eve had two sons: the elder of them was named Cain; which name, when it is interpreted, signifies a possession: the young
